metrics.label: Total costs
metrics.definition: Total nursing-home costs (page 27, line 15) per resident day.

metrics.label: Total revenue
metrics.definition: Total nursing-home revenue (page 30) per resident day.

metrics.label: Operating margin
metrics.definition: (Revenue - costs) / revenue, nursing home only.

metrics.label: Nursing care (direct care)
metrics.definition: Nursing and aide salaries, nursing agency and their benefits, per resident day.

metrics.label: Dietary, all-in
metrics.definition: Kitchen staff and benefits, food, supplies and contracts, per resident day.

metrics.label: Housekeeping, all-in
metrics.definition: Housekeeping staff and benefits, supplies and contracts, per resident day.

metrics.label: Laundry, all-in
metrics.definition: Laundry staff and benefits, supplies and contracts, per resident day.

metrics.label: All other staff and benefits
metrics.definition: Remaining salaries and benefits (administration, maintenance, activities, therapy staff, etc.), per resident day.

metrics.label: Other professional fees
metrics.definition: Fees in lieu of salaries other than nursing agency (therapy, medical director, consultants), per resident day.

metrics.label: Administrative and general
metrics.definition: Administrative and general costs other than salaries and benefits, including management fees, per resident day.

metrics.label: Resident care supplies
metrics.definition: Drugs, medical supplies, oxygen, lab, recreation and other resident care costs, per resident day.

metrics.label: Plant operation and utilities
metrics.definition: Repairs, heat, light and power, water and equipment leases, per resident day.

metrics.label: Building and property
metrics.definition: Rent, depreciation, amortization and property taxes, per resident day.

metrics.label: Interest
metrics.definition: Interest expense, per resident day.

metrics.label: Insurance
metrics.definition: Insurance, per resident day.

metrics.label: Raw food (homes that buy their own)
metrics.definition: Raw food line (page 18, 2a1) per resident day, only when the home buys its own food.

metrics.label: Management fees
metrics.definition: Administrative management services (page 16, line m12) per resident day.

metrics.label: Rent on leased real property
metrics.definition: Page 22, line 9, per resident day.

metrics.label: Rent or lease paid to related parties
metrics.definition: Readable itemized page 4 lines whose service describes rent or a lease, per resident day.

metrics.label: Itemized costs reported for related parties
metrics.definition: Readable itemized costs on page 4 and its continuation pages, per resident day. Loans, balances, attachment summary rows, duplicates and unreadable rows are excluded.

metrics.label: Nursing agency (pool)
metrics.definition: Nursing pool fees for RNs, LPNs and aides (page 13), per resident day.

metrics.label: Utilities
metrics.definition: Heat, light and power, and water (page 22, 6b-6d), per resident day.

metrics.label: Direct care share of costs
metrics.definition: Direct care as a share of total costs.

metrics.label: Nursing hours per resident day (cost report)
metrics.definition: Paid nursing and aide hours (pages 10 and 13) per resident day.

metrics.label: Nursing hours per resident day (PBJ, same months)
metrics.definition: CMS Payroll-Based Journal hours worked for the same months.

metrics.label: Medicaid share of days
metrics.definition: Connecticut Medicaid days as a share of all care days.

method.values: Every figure comes from the home's DSS cost report as published on the Cost Reports page, per resident day of the nursing home. Figures that failed a range check there are left out here.
method.bands: The shaded band is the middle half of Connecticut homes that year (25th to 75th percentile) and the line inside it the median, from full-year filings that passed every check.
method.constant_dollars: Constant dollars multiply each cost year by the ratio of CPI-U (all urban consumers, US city average) for cost year 2025 to CPI-U for that cost year, each averaged over October to September. It removes general inflation only.
method.events: Ownership changes are CMS change-of-ownership records; management companies are CMS management of record (with DPH); administrators are DPH records. They show what changed and when, not why.
method.peer_groups: Peer groups: management company of record in any cost year, CMS affiliated entity (chain), Connecticut planning region (CMS county field), certified beds, CMS ownership type, and Medicaid share of days in the home's latest report.
method.not_quality: These are the homes' own reported costs. They are not a measure of care quality and are not rankings.
